SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_ids, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_rl, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id<900 THEN n.net_sales END) AS stores, SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales END) AS web, SUM(n.net_sales) AS total, count(*) AS nrows
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id<900 THEN net_sales END) AS stores_rpt, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN net_sales END) AS web_rpt, SUM(net_sales) AS total_rpt, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT (business_date, store_id)) AS dist
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<>999
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order) AS orders, (SELECT count(DISTINCT web_order_id) FROM fact_web_order) AS dist_orders,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line) AS rets, (SELECT count(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line) AS dist_rets,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_key IS NULL) AS ret_nostore,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_return_line r LEFT JOIN dim_product s ON s.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.product_key IS NULL) AS ret_noprod,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line r LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key WHERE s.store_key IS NULL) AS sl_nostore,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line r LEFT JOIN dim_product s ON s.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.product_key IS NULL) AS sl_noprod,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_storekey,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT product_key FROM dim_product GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_prodkey,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND (w.web_order_id IS NULL OR w.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected'))) AS web_lines_undispatched,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id<900) AS store_lines_in_weborders

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, s.store_id=900 AS is_web, sum(f.quantity<=0) AS nonpos_qty, sum(f.net_amount<=0) AS nonpos_net, sum(f.staff_purchase_flag::INT) AS staff, sum((f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate) - f.gross_amount > 0.05 OR f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate) - f.gross_amount < -0.05)::INT) AS vat_mismatch, count(*) n,
 sum((s.store_id=999)::INT) AS s999, sum((p.category='ZZ Test')::INT) AS zz
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ty.net_sales AS net_sales_this_year, ly.net_sales AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week

SELECT d.fiscal_year, sum(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount END) AS excluded_net, sum(f.net_amount) AS all_net_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
